statements.quote: Finally, the present study administered a subjective questionnaire to assess the specific impact of ChatGPT on their learning experience in the following aspects: Current learning motivation; Future learning motivation; Learning attitude; Learning performance; Acquire Knowledge, see the supplementary materials for all detailed scales.
statements.locator: p. 3, Section 2.2 Task and assessment, Assessment of the subjective perceptions (final sentence)

statements.quote: To ensure a strictly standardized instructional baseline, participants were provided with the exact same brief guideline prior to the interaction, explaining how to establish a learning-oriented dialogue with the AI instructor: “In this experiment, you will act as a learner, and ChatGPT will serve as your instructor to guide and assist you in completing the creativity learning tasks. You may communicate with ChatGPT by asking questions, for example: (i) ‘Please act as a teacher and teach me some strategies for creativity and divergent thinking, such as association or decomposition.’ (ii) ‘I’m thinking about different uses for books—how can I generate more novel ideas?’ (iii) ‘Are there any more original ideas?’ You may also interrupt or follow up on ChatGPT’s responses to generate new questions and promote deeper interaction.
statements.locator: p. 4, Section 2.3 Experimental factor, standardized AI guideline and example prompts

statements.quote: Additionally, the backup basic learning materials, same as human-instructor teaching content, covering association, decomposition, adaptation, and combination techniques are provided for participants. Detailed content is available in the supplementary materials.
statements.locator: p. 4, Section 2.3 Experimental factor, backup learning materials

statements.quote: Importantly, the entire chat history for every participant was recorded and securely stored by the experimental platform. These chat logs were continuously monitored by the researchers during the session to ensure that the AI adhered to the heuristic instructional protocol and generated no task-irrelevant content.
statements.locator: p. 4, Section 2.3 Experimental factor, recording and storage of chat logs

statements.quote: To ensure instructional consistency, standardized scripts outlining the lecture process and content were provided to instructors three days before the experiment, allowing them to review and rehearse the session. Based on previous studies (Sun et al., 2019, 2020), the scripts (see Supplementary Materials) incorporated association, decomposition, and combination strategies, and the content were reviewed and refined by three professors with over ten years of teaching experience to ensure both pedagogical coherence and procedural consistency.
statements.locator: p. 4, Section 2.3 Experimental factor, human-instructor scripts

statements.quote: Detailed specifications of the optical probe configuration and channel locations are provided in the Supplementary Materials.
Detailed specifications of the optical sources, detector positions, and channel positions are provided in the Supplementary Materials (Fig. S1, Table S1).
statements.locator: p. 5, Section 2.5 fNIRS data acquisition and preprocessing, Data acquisition

statements.quote: The preprocessing of raw data was conducted using the HOMER2 MATLAB package (Huppert et al., 2009; version 2023b; Mathworks, Inc., USA).
statements.locator: p. 5, Section 2.5 fNIRS data acquisition and preprocessing, Preprocessing (software used; no code-release claim)

statements.quote: Results showed no significant differences, hence exclude group effect, see supplementary materials for descriptive stats for all Means and SDs, Table S2).
statements.locator: p. 5, Section 3 Results, pre-test group-homogeneity paragraph

statements.quote: Both the current and future learning motivations were positive and did not differ from each other, (p > 0.05; see Supplementary Fig. S2).
statements.locator: p. 7, Section 3.2 Subjective perception, Perceived usefulness, ease of use, and learning intention

statements.quote: Supplementary data to this article can be found online at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chbah.2026.100288.
The data are available from the corresponding authors for research purposes only.

The paper describes supplementary questionnaires, teaching scripts/backup materials, optical-probe specifications (Fig. S1/Table S1), descriptive means and SDs (Table S2), and motivation results (Fig. S2). Those files were not retrieved, so their names, count, sizes, contents, participant identifiers, arm fields, scores, texts and license remain unverified. The article's CC BY-NC-ND notice is not evidence of a participant-data license. notes: Checked 2026-10-09. Read all 89,961 characters of the saved markdown, including Appendix A and all references (14-page journal version of record), and checked the relevant statements against PDF text on pp. 3-5, 7 and 12. Quotes preserve the paper's wording; PDF line wrapping, discretionary hyphenation, the wrapped human-instructor compound and the wrapped DOI URL are normalized. No preregistration, original analysis-code release, or public participant-data repository is named. The form's data_and_code contains the author-availability statement and no URL. The only availability-related URL in the paper is the article DOI; its HTTP 200 redirect page and the publisher landing-page HTTP 403 are recorded in the deposit entry. No relevant deposit was identified by full/short title, first-author name (including reversed-name checks), or article DOI in the named services. Search counts are API totals; failed requests have null counts, not zero. Unrelated DataCite hits were excluded after metadata review and are documented in searches. No qualifying repository was identified for a file/children API listing, and no data file was downloaded or columns inspected. Classification on_request follows the explicit p. 12 statement that data are available from the corresponding authors for research purposes only. Confidence is medium because publisher supplementary files could not be inspected; HTTP 403 alone does not establish account-required access or prove the files are absent. No newly verified public data permit calculation of the missing human/control arm means and SDs (final.open_items open_questions[1]), resolution of the printed AI post-test flexibility discrepancy (open_questions[0]), clarification of within-person originality or transfer-item aggregation (open_questions[4]-[5]), or confirmation of Table S2's coverage. Participant-level SEs, independently verified analyzed counts and diversity measures from AUT responses or chat logs also cannot be computed from a confirmed public deposit. Chat histories were recorded according to p. 4, but their public availability is not established. No author was contacted.
